steps.title: Understand who supplies tool access
steps.body: Chat MCP Tools exposes tools chosen for a Persona through MCP Core. Selection and permissions originate in Persona MCP, not here. This page explains readiness: a tool appears for a chat only when the Persona allows it and MCP Core permits it. Opening this page never grants or runs a tool.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Distinguish tool selection from execution
steps.body: Read this Persona's selected tools and their availability. Selection, MCP Core approval and a running server are separate requirements. A later chat request can test an allowed tool, but opening this guide executes nothing. Use the related Persona MCP or MCP Core guides when you need to inspect another permission layer.
